credits_text: Nothing in the Light Films presents BRANCA DRACULA, RACHEL O'CONNOR, JEFF JENNER, JENNIFER JACOBS, GINGER KOCH, KIRSTEN TEMPLE and STEVEN CLAUS. Directed by STEVEN AGUILERA.
other_text: In October of 1894 three students disappeared in the woods near Transylvania, Romania while shooting a documentary. A year later their footage was found.
description: A black-and-white poster features three individuals in early 20th-century attire, with one holding a vintage camera, set against a dark forest backdrop.
